summary: Two-path destructor selected by flag a2. When (a2 & 2) is set, treats this as a pointer one DWORD past an array header: reads the element count from *(this - 1), walks the 200-byte-stride array in reverse calling ShortComputation_62a0 on each element, and frees the header block at this - 1. When (a2 & 2) is clear, treats this as a single element: calls ShortComputation_62a0 on this directly. On both paths, (a2 & 1) additionally triggers FreeWrapper_7bcf on the block; the function returns the base pointer it processed.

operations.description: Branch on flag (a2 & 2) != 0 selecting the array-header path over the single-element path.
Read the array count v3 = *(this - 1), seed the reverse walk v5 = &this[50 * v3] and counter v6 = v3 - 1.
Guard on (v3 - 1) >= 0; a zero or negative count skips the element loop.
do-while over v3 elements: step the walk pointer back 200 bytes and call ShortComputation_62a0 on each element in reverse order.
On the array path, branch on (a2 & 1) to decide whether to free the header block.
Free the array header block at this - 1 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return the processed base pointer this - 1 on the array path.
Single-element path: call ShortComputation_62a0 on this.
On the single-element path, branch on (a2 & 1) to decide whether to free this.
Free the single element block this via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return the processed base pointer this on the single-element path.
